comparison.objective: Release a disc from a case hub and insert it upright into a slot-loading console.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual press-and-lift release, thin-edge grasp, reorientation, and narrow-slot insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Disc reaches the required depth upright and centered without being dropped; the drive takes it.
comparison.reason: The press-release and insertion sequence is materially different from fine hex engagement, bounded tightening, collar tuning, and repeated impact testing.
